_meta.title: Settings
_meta.description: API tokens, networks allowed for API password sign-in and graph sharing.

title: Settings
tokens_intro: A token is needed by the REST API, Python SDK, MCP server and watchers: Authorization: Bearer sk-... Requests with a token are not checked against the IP list. The token value is shown once, when it is created.
token_copy_now: Copy the token now. After this window closes only its last characters are shown.
token_shown_once: Token {name} is shown only once. Copy it now.
ips_scope: The list is checked only for API sign-in with login and password. Requests with a token and web sign-in are not limited by it.
ips_seen_as: Your address as the server sees it: {ip}
ips_invalid: Enter a network in CIDR notation, for example 192.0.2.0/24
ips_empty: No networks: API sign-in with login and password is refused until a network is added
sharing_rights_help: Read: open a graph, calculate paths and failures. Write: also layout, hostnames, YAML. Only the owner can delete a graph.
share_no_graphs: You have no graphs to share
alr_tpl_bandwidth: Low free bandwidth on a link (TE)
alr_role_overload: Node in maintenance (OSPF max-metric, IS-IS overload)
alr_role_abr: Source of routes from other areas / IS-IS level
alr_change_default_route_down_one: lost by one of the sources
alr_change_prefix_down_one: lost by one of the sources
alr_err_prefix_format: The prefix is not valid, for example 10.0.0.0/8
alr_err_threshold: Enter a threshold N above 0 (for % no more than 100)
alr_err_internal: Internal addresses are not reachable from topolograph.com
alr_err_secret: The signing secret must be at least 32 characters
alr_failure_timeout: The address did not answer within 5 s
alr_failure_internal_address: Internal addresses are not reachable from topolograph.com
alr_failure_telegram_rejected: Telegram rejected the token or chat_id
alr_failure_email_limit: email: the daily limit of messages is used up
alr_forecast_hour_one: From events over the last {span}: about {count} message per hour
alr_forecast_hour_few: From events over the last {span}: about {count} messages per hour
alr_forecast_hour_many: From events over the last {span}: about {count} messages per hour
alr_forecast_hour_other: From events over the last {span}: about {count} messages per hour
alr_forecast_day_one: From events over the last {span}: about {count} message per day
alr_forecast_day_few: From events over the last {span}: about {count} messages per day
alr_forecast_day_many: From events over the last {span}: about {count} messages per day
alr_forecast_day_other: From events over the last {span}: about {count} messages per day
alr_forecast_week_one: From events over the last {span}: about {count} message per day, {week} per week
alr_forecast_week_few: From events over the last {span}: about {count} messages per day, {week} per week
alr_forecast_week_many: From events over the last {span}: about {count} messages per day, {week} per week
alr_forecast_week_other: From events over the last {span}: about {count} messages per day, {week} per week
